name: PauseAI brand tokens
source: Extracted from pauseai-website-es. Update if PauseAI Global publishes a canonical token set.

orange.role: Primary brand color. Use as dominant accent or as brand-forward fill.

orangeDeep.role: Darker orange for gradient endpoints. Avoid on apparel screen prints.

orangeBright.role: Brighter orange for gradient highlights. Avoid on apparel screen prints.

orangeQr.role: Darker, apparel-safe orange for the standalone brand QR (modules + finders) where a white background is expected (posters, slides). ~4.9:1 on white vs the brand orange's ~2.2:1, so codes scan reliably. Tee backs use monochrome ink/paper on the bare fabric instead (see FG_COLOR in build-qr.py). Front/statement art keeps the brand orange.

ink.role: Primary text/fill on light backgrounds. Softer than pure black for print.

paper.role: Primary text/fill on dark backgrounds; background on light items.

spacing.logoClearSpace: Height of the logo's capital 'P', applied as padding on all four sides of any logo placement.
